title: Exact Elastodynamic Homogenization of Laminated Composites Revisited
summary: This paper revisits Willis' elastodynamic homogenization (Mechanics of Materials, 41 (2009) 385-393) of periodic laminate composites and uses the equivalent inclusion-based method (EIM) to evaluate the unique effective constitutive properties with eigen-fields. The microstructure-specific Green's function is essential in Willis's exact homogenization method, which was derived from the corresponding periodic laminates.
